description: Picked for them, not the store: searches the fixed bank of 255 gift ideas by interest, by keyword, or by both, with optional recipient and budget-band filters. Returns up to 10 matches in bank order, each with a one-line description, a why-line, one buying note, its budget band, a photo link, and a link that opens that exact idea on thepresentpicker.com. The result reports the total number of matches, including when there are none.

interest.description: Optional: one bank interest: cooking, outdoors, tech, books, fitness, cozy, music, games, gardening, travel, science.

keyword.description: Optional: plain words to match against gift names and descriptions, e.g. 'coffee', 'science kit', 'board game'. Every word must match, so a named item finds its exact bank entry.

limit.description: Optional: max results to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

name: search_gifts
title: Search gift ideas
